name: Easy!Appointments
summary: Simple self-hosted booking system. Good for service businesses (coaches, salons, consultants).
gains: You own all your customer data
tradeoffs: You need a small server and must keep it updated
setupSteps: Rent a small server (e.g. a $5–6/mo VPS) or use one you already have
Install with Docker using the official docker-compose file
Open the setup page in your browser and create the admin account
Add your services, working hours and connect Google Calendar
